name: ai-integrator
description: Local-first native control plane for coding agents

scripts.check: npm run check:bridge && npm --prefix apps/desktop run check && cargo check --workspace
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/desktop run test && cargo test --workspace
scripts.format: npm --prefix apps/desktop run format && cargo fmt --all -- --check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/desktop run lint && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
